learning_objective: Digital performance dimulai dari business problem, bukan langsung dari channel. Pahami model bisnis, revenue, variable cost, margin, customer acquisition, repeat purchase, dan payback. Pisahkan growth, efficiency, serta profitability. CAC, LTV, AOV, contribution margin, dan retention perlu definisi dan periode yang konsisten. Marketing dapat memperbesar demand, tetapi tidak otomatis memperbaiki distribusi, stok, harga, kualitas produk, atau kapasitas sales.

practice_deliverable: Buat business analysis satu halaman: model bisnis, target customer, product/price, revenue stream, cost structure, contribution margin, AOV, CAC, asumsi repeat/LTV, sales funnel, tiga risiko operasional, dan tiga marketing implications. Gunakan angka SIMULATED, tulis rumus dan sumber/asumsi.
evidence_section_or_excerpt: OpenStax Chapter 3 directly teaches contribution margin, CVP, break-even and sensitivity; SBA calculator gives a practical break-even formula. Neither source teaches acquisition-cost, LTV/cohort-retention or digital payback methodology.
disposition: PARTIAL — first-pass source-fit desk review; formal acceptance OPEN.
gap_or_next_action: Digital CAC, fully-loaded acquisition cost, cohort LTV, repeat/retention, contribution after media and payback period; Indonesian accounting/tax treatment and multi-product mix need a marketing-finance SME and a synthetic worked case. Next action: Add a synthetic multi-product unit-economics workbook with acquisition, cohort retention/LTV and payback; validate formulas with an accounting/finance SME and local tax caveats.
desk_review_evidence: OpenStax Chapter 3 directly teaches contribution margin, CVP, break-even and sensitivity; SBA calculator gives a practical break-even formula. Neither source teaches acquisition-cost, LTV/cohort-retention or digital payback methodology.
desk_review_gaps: Digital CAC, fully-loaded acquisition cost, cohort LTV, repeat/retention, contribution after media and payback period; Indonesian accounting/tax treatment and multi-product mix need a marketing-finance SME and a synthetic worked case.

learning_objective: Consumer research mengubah asumsi audience menjadi pemahaman untuk memilih proposition, pesan, dan channel. Bedakan data primer (interview, survey, observation, usability test) dari data sekunder (CRM, sales, search, social listening, review, industry report). Segmentasi yang berguna dibangun dari kebutuhan, perilaku, konteks, motivasi, dan decision criteria, bukan demografi saja. Positioning menentukan ruang pembeda brand; value proposition menyatakan nilai; proof point memberi alasan untuk percaya.

practice_deliverable: Buat consumer snapshot dua segmen: job-to-be-done, need, tension, trigger, barrier, alternatives, purchase criteria, media behavior, proposition, proof, dan evidence. Tambahkan positioning statement serta tiga asumsi yang perlu diuji.

learning_objective: Funnel dan customer journey adalah alat diagnosis, bukan diagram linear yang selalu sama untuk semua kategori. Definisikan outcome bisnis terlebih dahulu, lalu petakan tindakan, pertanyaan, hambatan, dan touchpoint. KPI tree menghubungkan business outcome dengan driver dan diagnostic metric. Setiap metric perlu definisi, formula, unit, sumber data, owner, window, dan guardrail. Hindari vanity metrics dan jangan membandingkan metrik dengan denominator berbeda.

learning_objective: Integrated channel planning menetapkan peran channel berdasarkan audience, objective, journey, creative capability, cost, reach/intent, dan measurement. Paid, owned, earned, shared menjelaskan cara distribusi/ownership, bukan daftar channel eksklusif. Media mix tidak ditentukan dengan membagi budget rata atau mengikuti tren. Buat rationale tiap channel, proyeksi dengan asumsi, flighting, dan evaluasi. Forecast adalah estimasi, bukan janji.

chapter_title: Paid Search, Paid Social & Programmatic Fundamentals

Search merespons query/intent; social ads menggabungkan audience signal dan creative untuk menstimulasi demand; programmatic mengakses inventory lintas publisher melalui DSP, SSP, exchange, auction, atau deal. Objective, audience, creative, conversion signal, bidding, inventory quality, privacy, dan measurement berbeda antarpublisher. Full-stack planner memilih channel, memberi brief yang benar, dan menilai output specialist.

GA4 memakai event-based model; UTM mengklasifikasikan traffic campaign; Google Tag Manager mengelola tag/trigger/variable; pixel/API mengirim signal ke platform iklan. Attribution memberi credit menurut model/window tertentu, bukan otomatis kausalitas. Dashboard rapi tidak memperbaiki event yang salah.

learning_objective: CRO dan experimentation mengubah diagnosis funnel menjadi hipotesis yang diuji. CRO bukan hanya mengubah warna tombol; ia menggabungkan research, analytics, usability, page performance, offer clarity, trust, friction, dan operational constraints. Hipotesis menyebut observation, insight, change, expected mechanism, audience, dan metric. A/B testing memerlukan randomization, unit tepat, primary metric, guardrails, sample/duration, stopping rule, serta kontrol kontaminasi. Conversion rate naik belum tentu profit naik bila kualitas order turun.

Jangan mengklaim significance tanpa perhitungan benar.

Rancang komunikasi berdasarkan lifecycle stage, segment, trigger, content, timing, frequency, suppression, exit condition, dan consent. Email/WhatsApp bukan sekadar channel blast; keduanya memerlukan permission, preference management, deliverability, data hygiene, dan customer-service coordination. Ukur activation, repeat rate, retention, churn, revenue/margin, dan customer experience.

Planner harus menulis masalah yang dapat dipengaruhi komunikasi, mendefinisikan audience, perubahan perilaku/persepsi yang diharapkan, baseline, periode, dan constraint. chapter_title: Cultural Insight, Human Tension & Behavioral Insight
learning_objective: Cultural insight menghubungkan perubahan konteks budaya, perilaku nyata, kebutuhan manusia, dan ketegangan yang relevan dengan kategori. Tren hanya sinyal; insight menjelaskan mengapa sinyal tersebut penting bagi audience dan brand. Human tension biasanya memuat dua kebutuhan yang bertabrakan. Fraud indicators bukan bukti final; sudden spikes, generic comments, bot-like profiles, engagement pods, and inconsistent geo perlu investigasi. Gunakan third-party tools sebagai signal, bukan verdict tunggal. Simpan evidence dan decision rationale.

practice_deliverable: Buat creator vetting scorecard untuk lima candidates dengan audience fit, ER context, quality, fake signal checks, brand safety, history, and accept/reject/risk decision.
evidence_section_or_excerpt: YouTube prohibits artificial inflation of YouTube engagement; TikTok One documents platform-specific audience/engagement measures; ANA supplies metric definitions, not an authentication/fraud detector.
disposition: PARTIAL
gap_or_next_action: Require native insight exports, dated baselines, platform-specific definitions, creator clarification, sample review and confidence/limitations. Validate third-party tools independently before rejection.
desk_review_evidence: YouTube prohibits artificial inflation of YouTube engagement; TikTok One documents platform-specific audience/engagement measures; ANA supplies metric definitions, not an authentication/fraud detector.
desk_review_gaps: No reviewed source establishes universal cross-platform fake-follower detection, engagement-pod tests or third-party fraud-score thresholds. Suspicious growth/comments are risk indicators, not proof.

learning_objective: Influencer strategy menerjemahkan objective menjadi creator roles, tier mix, campaign concept, timeline, budget, and KPI. Campaign brief perlu menjelaskan audience, insight, message, content role, deliverables, creative freedom, mandatories, CTA, disclosure, and usage rights. Creator plan harus memperhitungkan audience overlap, product availability, seasonality, production capacity, and cross-channel amplification.

desk_review_gaps: Not a complete Indonesia campaign-planning method or ratecard; does not resolve budget normalization, audience overlap, seasonality, cross-platform allocation or incrementality.

learning_objective: KOL brief harus memberi strategic direction tetapi tidak membunuh creator authenticity. Brief memuat campaign context, audience, product truth, key message, proof, do/don't, story role, platform/format, deliverables, CTA, disclosure, mandatory, and approval. Storyline harus menunjukkan pengalaman atau explanation yang believable. Approval flow membutuhkan SLA dan batas revisi agar creator autonomy dan brand safety seimbang.

desk_review_gaps: EPI is an industry code, not statute. Permendag 19/2026 applies within PMSE/electronic-ad scope. Platform disclosure does not exhaust local compliance; category claims, minors and substantiation need specialist review.

learning_objective: Negotiation dan contract mengikat scope, fee, deliverables, payment terms, usage rights, exclusivity, whitelisting, revisions, cancellations, disclosure, performance claims, IP, confidentiality, and remedies. Creator fee tidak otomatis mencakup perpetual paid usage. Buyer harus memisahkan organic posting license, paid amplification, raw footage, cutdowns, edit, territory, channels, and duration.

learning_objective: Seeding dan barter membangun trial/relationship tetapi bukan gratis: product cost, packaging, shipping, staff time, and content rights tetap ada. Seeding harus punya target, reason, opt-in, logistics, brief, and post-send follow-up. Barter harus menyebut deliverables atau menyatakan tidak ada guarantee. Relationship management meliputi CRM creator, communication, feedback, payment, and long-term trust.

learning_objective: Influencer measurement harus mencocokkan KPI dengan creator role: awareness (reach/unique, view quality), engagement (saves/shares/comments), content quality, traffic, lead/sales, and advocacy. Attribution dipengaruhi codes/links, platform windows, view-through, and overlap. Cost metrics seperti CPM/CPE/CPV perlu denominator dan format yang sesuai. ROI harus mempertimbangkan fee, production, rights, seeding, amplification, discounts, and margin.

Performance terms harus menjelaskan eligible action, attribution window, commission basis, validation, reversal, fraud, payout, and margin. Affiliate bukan sinonim influencer; creator dapat berperan sebagai affiliate bila commercial model menekankan tracked sale/commission.
